description: Admin UI improvements + SearchBar enhancements: items 11–15 (admin bulk actions, admin preview modal, search history chips, keyboard shortcut). Independent of FEAT-002 public UI changes; depends on FEAT-001 for dark mode removal. Also covers item #19 (inline status toggle replacing publish/unpublish button) and item #20 (unsaved changes warning on UploadForm).
steps:
STEP 1 — Item #11: Bulk actions in PapersTable (src/components/PapersTable.tsx). Add state: `const [selected, setSelected] = useState>(new Set())` and `const [bulkBusy, setBulkBusy] = useState(false)`. Add a checkbox column: in the desktop table thead, prepend a new with a 'select all' checkbox: ` 0 && filtered.every(p => selected.has(p.id))} onChange={e => { if (e.target.checked) setSelected(new Set(filtered.map(p => p.id))); else setSelected(new Set()); }} />`. In each tbody row, prepend a with a row checkbox. Add a bulk action bar above the table (when selected.size > 0): `
{selected.size} selected
`. Implement `bulkAction(status: string)`: setBulkBusy(true), await Promise.all(Array.from(selected).map(id => fetch('/api/papers/'+id, { method:'PATCH', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({status}) }))), update local papers state, setSelected(new Set()), setBulkBusy(false). Implement `bulkDelete()`: confirm dialog first, then Promise.all deletes. Also replicate the checkbox logic in the mobile card view. Update colSpan from 8 to 9 on the empty-row td.

STEP 2 — Item #19: Inline status toggle in PapersTable (src/components/PapersTable.tsx). Make the status badge in the Status column clickable to call toggleStatus(paper). Replace the existing status <span> in the desktop table with: `<button onClick={() => toggleStatus(paper)} disabled={busy === paper.id} title='Click to toggle status' className={['cursor-pointer inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors', paper.status === 'published' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 hover:bg-red-100 hover:text-red-700' : 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 hover:bg-green-100 hover:text-green-700', 'disabled:opacity-50'].join(' ')}>{busy === paper.id ? '…' : paper.status}</button>`. Remove the separate Publish/Unpublish button from the Actions column for both desktop and mobile — keep only Edit and Delete in Actions. Update the mobile card view similarly: replace the Publish/Unpublish button with the status badge button approach, and remove the separate publish button from the flex row.

STEP 3 — Item #12: Admin paper quick preview modal in PapersTable (src/components/PapersTable.tsx). Add state: `const [previewPaperId, setPreviewPaperId] = useState(null)` and `const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(null)` and `const [previewLoading, setPreviewLoading] = useState(false)` and `const [previewFileType, setPreviewFileType] = useState('pdf')`. Add a `openPreview(paper)` async function: setPreviewPaperId(paper.id), setPreviewLoading(true), const res = await fetch('/api/papers/'+paper.id+'/download'), if res.ok: const {url} = await res.json(), setPreviewUrl(url), setPreviewFileType(paper.file_type ?? 'pdf'), setPreviewLoading(false). Add a 'Preview' button to each row's actions (desktop and mobile), positioned before Edit: ``. Add the modal overlay at the bottom of the returned JSX, outside the table: `{previewPaperId && (
setPreviewPaperId(null)} role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label='Paper preview'>...
)}`. Inside the modal: a white container (max-w-3xl w-full mx-4 rounded-xl bg-white shadow-2xl overflow-hidden), with a header row (title of paper + close button), and the content: if previewLoading show a spinner; if previewUrl and fileType==='pdf' show `

STEP 4 — Item #13: Search history chips in SearchBar (src/components/SearchBar.tsx). Add state: `const [searchHistory, setSearchHistory] = React.useState([])` and `const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = React.useState(false)`. On mount (useEffect), read `JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pq:searchHistory') ?? '[]')` and setSearchHistory. When the search form submits (after debounce fires a non-empty value), persist: `const next = [term, ...prev.filter(h => h !== term)].slice(0, 5); localStorage.setItem('pq:searchHistory', JSON.stringify(next)); setSearchHistory(next)`. Add onFocus and onBlur (with 150ms delay to allow chip click) handlers to the input. Show chips below the input when `isFocused && value === '' && searchHistory.length > 0`: a div `absolute top-full left-0 right-0 z-10 mt-1 rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white p-2 shadow-lg`. Inside: `

Recent searches

` then `
{searchHistory.map((h, i) => )}}
`. On Escape key in the input's onKeyDown handler (already exists), also call `setIsFocused(false)`. Update the save-to-history call: trigger it in the existing debounce handler when nextValue is non-empty.

STEP 5 — Item #14: Keyboard shortcut '/' to focus search in SearchBar (src/components/SearchBar.tsx). Add a ref to the input: `const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)` and attach it to the <input ref={inputRef}>. Add a useEffect: `React.useEffect(() => { function handler(e: KeyboardEvent) { if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement?.tagName !== 'INPUT' && document.activeElement?.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA' && document.activeElement?.tagName !== 'SELECT') { e.preventDefault(); inputRef.current?.focus(); } } document.addEventListener('keydown', handler); return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handler); }, [])`. Add a visual hint inside the input area: to the right of the search icon area but only visible when input is empty, add a `<kbd>` element positioned absolutely right-10 (to not conflict with clear button) that shows `/` — but only on desktop: `{!value && <kbd aria-hidden className='pointer-events-none absolute right-10 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 hidden sm:inline-flex items-center rounded border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono text-gray-400 select-none'>/</kbd>}`. The existing clear button uses `right-3`; the kbd uses `right-10` to not overlap.

STEP 6 — Item #20: Unsaved changes warning in UploadForm (src/components/UploadForm.tsx). Track form dirtiness by comparing current values to initial values. Add state: `const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false)`. Define initial values based on editPaper prop (these are memoized once). In each field's onChange handler, after updating state, also call `setIsDirty(true)`. On successful submit, call `setIsDirty(false)`. Add a useEffect that attaches/detaches the beforeunload listener: `useEffect(() => { if (!isDirty) return; function handleBeforeUnload(e: BeforeUnloadEvent) { e.preventDefault(); e.returnValue = ''; } window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload); return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload); }, [isDirty])`. This triggers the browser's native 'Leave page?' dialog when isDirty is true and the user tries to navigate away.
acceptance_criteria: PapersTable has a checkbox column; selecting rows shows a bulk action bar with Publish all, Unpublish all, Delete all buttons.
Status badge in PapersTable is clickable and toggles status directly; no separate Publish/Unpublish button in Actions column.
Each PapersTable row has a Preview button that opens a modal with the paper content.
SearchBar shows recent search chips when focused with empty input; chips can be clicked or removed.
Pressing '/' focuses the search input when not already in a text field; a '/' hint badge is visible on desktop.
UploadForm tracks dirty state and shows browser unload warning when form has unsaved changes.
npm run build passes with zero errors.
